metadata.counting_caliber: system_prompt + user_prompt joined by newline, matching exactly what the probe battery sends to an OpenAI-compatible endpoint (system message + user message). This is the same string the self-hosted reference_server encodes, so a reference backend's reported usage.prompt_tokens line up with these reference counts.
metadata.note: Real prompt-token counts measured with the Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct tokenizer (downloaded via HF_ENDPOINT=hf-mirror). Behavioral distributions are NOT captured (no local generation); for open-source behavioral references see the Zenodo 176-model fingerprint dataset (CC-BY-4.0) cited in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md. Tokenization is deterministic, so samples are identical by construction. IMPORTANT: with no behavioral reference, verify can only certify tokenizer-family consistency and must NOT output verdict=pass; it caps at insufficient_evidence.
